Katrina (Chairperson)
Hello, I am Katrina and I am the Chair of Trustees for Curlys Legacy. I have been a trustee since the Charity was first registered and it is a great pleasure to have been part of the growth and success of our Farm and school.
My background is somewhat eclectic having started in Catering & Hospitality management, running several operations across London. I then had my children and worked as a Childminder and also returned to University and attained a PGCE and began teaching various Child development courses in colleges.
One of my sons was diagnosed with Autism, which led me to becoming an Autism practioner and working to help others understand these young people better.
Since 2012 I have been the CEO of We Are Beams a Charity that supports Children with a disability. . Much of my work, has given me greater understanding of many issues, which helps with the role I have at Curly’s
Please feel free to get in touch or yell if you see me at the Farm!
Email: Katrina.a@ntlworld
Mobile: 07780 904287

pageCache.text:
Curly's Caravan Donors
Curly's Caravan was purchased with funds raised by two key donors, which we would like to thank. Without their hard work and generosity, we would not be in a position to give away so many memory making breaks to families in need.
Attitude Magazine Foundation attitudemagazinefoundation.com
Farmwood M&E Ltd. farmwood.co.uk
Additional funds were raised by community fundraising events as well as generous donations from individuals including Darren, Tom, Ranj, Amanda, Cliff, Rob, Steve & Angela. Thank you to you all!!
Tesco in Sheerness has also been incredibly generous by donating ALL of the bedding, kitchenware, crockery etc., in order for us to kit out Curly's Caravan as a comfortable home-from home. Thanks to Kay and her whole team at Tesco for their generosity. Tesco Sheerness now provides a welcome hamper for every family that uses our caravan. This generosity is greatly appreciated.
Harts Holiday Park are also supporting the families who use Curly's Caravan by offering FREE entertainment passes for every adult and child staying in the caravan. Thanks to Jade and the team for helping us make each family's holiday something to really remember.
Curly's Caravan

HARTS HOLIDAY PARK
Fundraising
HARTS HOLIDAY PARK
Special thanks to the Harts Holiday Park Team, based in Leysdown.
HARTS Holiday Park is based in Leysdown on The Isle of Sheppey and this is where the first CURLY'S CARAVAN is based.
As well as giving a very generous 50% discount on pitch fees, the team on the park give each family who stay in Curly's Caravan, free entertainment passes, for each member of the family.
Harts is a great holiday park for any family, and the families that use Curly's Caravan love it!
A massive thank you to Richard, Tanya, Donna and especially Jade for all their help!

Kirstie
Hello, my name is Kirstie.
I started at Curly’s Farm as a volunteer in 2020 and then became member of staff 2 years later.
I have 3 primary aged children, 2 of whom are autistic and I love the way they process problems differently.
My favourite animals on the farm are the Alpacas. You will often find me in their enclosure, either making them floofy or walking them around the farm.
